notes.title: Early access Waves Mode already available in demo version!
notes.content:
The long-awaited update with Waves mode 1.2.0 is already available!

Innovation:


1. Waves

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/3fd9cb16f25a01ce3c0ba86cf028a5c2e1642151.png

One of the main innovations is the “Waves". This mode is an endless spawn of enemies. 

Collect as many points as you can by killing mobs!


In the future, namely with the release of the game, there will be a leader on the board. 



New mobs in Waves:

- Svinonatka

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/44371f7a7bf98d25758f1f2519e0dbf069a3c453.png

The sow crawls around the map and spawns new enemies every 15 seconds. 


Possesses:

200 health units 

deals a blow to the arm for 4 health points

The movement speed is 400.



- The nos



The nose is a very mobile enemy. It can appear from the Sow or during the next round of waves.


Possesses:

50 health units 

he strikes with his hand for 6 health points

The movement speed is 600.

2. New weapons


- Minigun


Quick-firing, shoots bullets and deals 20 damage.


- RPG


Shoots rocket shells at the terrain. The missile does 120 damage.


- Plasmagane


It fires energy projectiles that deal 35 damage points.


- THE BOOK 


A hellish book that incinerates enemies with a single spell.

3. Achievements 


 We also added 8 achievements, unfortunately, they are not linked to Steam. In the demo version, they will be deleted in the future. Already in the full version, they will be linked to Steam as the leader of the playing field. 


 1. The door in the middle of the forest - Complete level 1

 2. 1488 - 1488 enemies killed

 3. Overdose - death 100 times

 4. The band is an 800 hp healing.

 5. AAAAAAAAA - 5,000 enemies killed (in waves)

 6. Mephedrone Rambo - Fired 6666 machine gun shots

 and 2 unlocked achievements.


Minor innovations:

- The design of the 1st level has been slightly updated and optimized. 
- Loading screen
- Renamed level 1
- Updated the level selection menu
- Removed the body of the character in the nightmare
- The toxic flower sound now plays better
- Nightmare lvl update 



	 	

	 	

Fixed:
- Fixed some trees
- Removed the character's body from "nightmare"
- The sound of "poisonous flower" is now reproduced better
- Fixed music looping in the menu
- Fixed music looping on level 1
- Changed the location of weapons



Changes after the beta version:

- Removed "War - Hexenkessel" (Waves)
- Updated mob designs

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Subsequent updates and development plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After a long break, we would like to share with future information about updates to the demo version of the game and much more.
At the moment, the demo version is very crude and was made this way due to the tight deadlines for the game event, but even after the game was released, we received positive feedback from some players who are really looking forward to this game.

Let's start with the prologue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/f1ba74d70ea405868772ba91da1c7645c4616641.png


The prologue was made in a hurry, it was supposed to reflect who the main character is and how he got here in the first place. 

We decided to completely abandon this prologue with the bodycam and make a prologue to suit the style of the game. 



Waves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/4648af2cd35b3100965104a7d204ed37efe92269.png


Subsequent updates to the demo version, which we are already working on. New mobs, mechanics and weapons will appear. This update will also show what game will be in the future.

Subsequent updates to the demo version we are already working on. New mobs, mechanics, music and weapons will appear. This update will also reveal what the game will be like in the future.

The release date is approximately November or December of this year. 


The demo version will have the same:
- Level 2 
- Level 1 development and optimization 
- Adding many gameplay settings and language settings.


What after the demo version updates?

At the moment, what the game is - this is our last result. The full version is unknown when it will be released. The game could come out in half a year, in a year or two? We won't guess the release date. The team has only 2 people with little experience in game development. We work at a moderate pace with full development of one or another aspect of the game. Therefore, you can not expect a full release of the game in the near future.
Also, after the demo version is completely finalized, don’t expect us to publish news about the game often. It will most likely go out of the game, but there is something else associated with it. We already have ideas, and I think that we will share them with them soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/1911d659bb1050fb41115690100f5cbf2b8ead68.png
